incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: POUNDING opened, but the local poundingcore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart POUNDING.

incompleteInstallation.title: POUNDING installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so poundingcore cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest POUNDING.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest POUNDING package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined POUNDING components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: POUNDING package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This POUNDING package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: POUNDING opened, but poundingcore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling POUNDING may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: POUNDING opened, but poundingcore stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling POUNDING may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: POUNDING opened, but poundingcore could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart POUNDING.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: POUNDING detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, POUNDING will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

transientConcurrentStartup.title: POUNDING is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another POUNDING startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart POUNDING.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.
